intro: Lesson 28. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ (٣١) وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ (٣٢) وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ (٣٣) فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ (٣٤) عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ (٣٥) هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ (٣٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Mutaffifin 83:31-36 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 83:31-36 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 83:31-36 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite all of Al-Mutaffifin to a partner.
questions.a: Thirty-six ayat with the rules applied.
A shaddah (a sukoon then a letter) follows the madd letter in the same word: madd lazim.
A) Those who believed. 83:34: 'So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers.'

questions.q: How many ayat are in Al-Mutaffifin?
Think again: The mockers called the believers 'truly lost' (83:32). On the Last Day who laughs? What does this teach us when people mock our faith?
questions.a: On that Day the believers laugh (83:34). We stay patient and firm; the end belongs to the believers.
